posts.post:
the bar for how men dress in this country is so low that a clean white tee makes you a 'fashion guy'.

we need to do better.
why is finding a heavy cotton tee that doesn't lose its shape after two washes like hunting for treasure?

there's always that one hoodie in the closet.

you know exactly which one i mean.

we spent six months just trying to get the collar height perfect.

most people won't even notice, but we know.
